page_title: 月神代理 — 让内网服务，拥有公网地址 | macOS / Windows

summary.name: 月神代理 (MoonProxy)
summary.one_liner: MoonProxy is a free, open-source desktop client for macOS and Windows that publishes local or intranet services (ERP, NAS, game servers, local web pages) to the public internet through a graphical interface.
keywords: share local web page with link
expose local website without cloud deployment
use_cases: Remotely access a company ERP, OA or finance system from outside the office
Host a Minecraft or Palworld game server for friends
Share an AI-generated HTML page or local demo with a public link
Reach a home NAS and files from a phone while travelling
Publish a self-hosted blog or docs site from a local machine
summary.what_it_does: MoonProxy wraps intranet tunneling in a graphical desktop panel: you add a tunnel by filling in a form with the service and port, then start or stop it with a toggle. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP and HTTPS tunnel rules and shows real connection status, with background health probes of local ports every 3 seconds. It can run at login in the system tray, and schedule tunnels to open during set working hours. The engine is bundled (frpc sidecar) and it self-updates from upstream GitHub releases with SHA256 verification. Per the page, it publishes only chosen services rather than the whole machine, unlike a VPN.
notable: Graphical tunnel management with no command line needed, built on Tauri v2 and Vue 3
Bundled frpc engine with scheduled working-hour tunnels and auto-restore after reboot
Open source under MIT license on GitHub (MoonProxyHQ/moonproxy-desktop)
Per-tunnel keys and the ability to publish only specific services instead of the whole machine
caveats: Requires a public relay server with a public IP (rent a cloud VPS, use a community node, or a serverless relay); the app does not provide one
Unsigned app on macOS may show a warning on first launch; workaround is right-click Open or running xattr -cr
Installers are listed for macOS (DMG) and Windows 64-bit only
